page.layout: One text column on the left of the scan. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Signature and catchword at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: nulla unquam in ciuitate sa-tis multæ leges omnibus de rebus scribi posint, magnaq; pars litium ac negotiorũ prudentiæ consilioque peritorũ hominũ necessariò permit-tenda sit: Romani, nõ ut ce-teræ gentes omnes, cuiuis iudici,arbitróue sumpto, maximarum quarumque rerum arbitriũ potestatemque per-miserunt : sed amplissimos quosq;, & clarissimos uiros, magnoque rerum usu prędi-tos, quasi ciuilis Iuris custo-des in hoc munere tanquam in prȩsidio aliquo locauerũt, à quibus reliqui ciues quid æquũ bonumque esset, cum usus

page.notes: The running head "IVRISCONSVLTVS" is printed with V for both vowel and consonant; normalised to IURISCONSULTUS per the u/v rule. "Romani" is set with a dotted letter that may be an m; read as Romani. The initial letter of the page is printed lowercase, so the text continues from the previous page. Print shows long-s forms that are normalised to s.
